title: DeclarationRecord
description: One verified product environmental declaration keyed to an estate material identity. Canonical JSON: object keys serialize in the property order declared here, indicator and module keys in the frozen roster order below; absent cells are OMITTED keys, never nulls or zeros - key presence IS the coverage census. Impact values are per declared_unit at the indicator's EN 15804+A2 unit.

material_key.description: The estate material identity the declaration binds - the consumer-side MaterialId spelling, supplied by the ingest keying row.

product.description: The declared product name as the registry publishes it.

issuer.description: The programme operator issuing the declaration (e.g. the EPD programme).

registration.description: The declaration's registration identity within its programme - with issuer, the duplicate-check pair.

standard.description: The EPD standard revision the declaration conforms to.

issued.description: The declaration's own issue date - the tie key two revisions of one registration differ on.

valid_until.description: The calendar expiry a consumer's resolution law compares.

indicators.description: The per-indicator per-module impact cells the producer DECLARES. A missing indicator key or module key is undeclared absence; a present cell is a measured value, negative cells valid biogenic or avoided-burden carbon.

recycled_content.description: Declared recycled-content mass fraction; omitted when the declaration carries none.

end_of_life_recovery.description: Declared end-of-life recovery fraction; omitted when the declaration carries none.

source.description: Registry provenance - which source row produced the record and its native identity there.

declaredUnit.description: The functional unit the declaration is published per - admitted at THAT unit, never renormalized.

indicator.description: The EN 15804+A2 core indicator roster, frozen in this order.

module.description: The EN 15978 module roster at declaration granularity, frozen in this order; consumers band as their own seam requires.
